proposed_facts.reason: Canonical WalkWait animation processing predecrements x8, enters Shoot on zero, and then independently tests remaining frames before entering literal 0x160. The replacement correctly removes exclusive or finishes-first wording.

Both cited bodies confirm the independent guards, horizontal-velocity clearing in Shoot entry, fixed transition arguments, and subsequent animation follow-up. An initially zero countdown is decremented before testing. Numeric-state naming remains appropriately deferred.

Independently inspected every citation: the local callback orders all three helpers; their bodies establish translation-derived XY velocity, horizontal target tracking, and current-position correction against floor 0. Selection can return NULL and the subsequent position read has no explicit no-target guard. The document explicitly preserves the nonnegative-cap assumption rather than establishing an unrestricted x68 range.

Local source confirms initialization after Wait entry, sequential Wait guards, Shoot completion handoff, Human-slot gating, and empty collision callbacks. The external helper copies the destination into move state and stores the deferred callback; TagCancel collision invokes it conditionally after clearing velocity. The document preserves assignment-before-test behavior and does not infer lifetime from rendered naming.

contradictions.reason: Accept the four upstream supersessions: finishes-first, instead, and alternate-transition descriptions obscure two sequential independent guards. Physics separately adjusts current position rather than predicting next-frame bounds, and Shoot completion preserves an external deferred continuation.

Accept deferral of all five compiled-pool fact claims and both pool-related links. Source literals establish arguments, not .sdata2 ownership, references, size, or layout. Literal 0x160 also does not independently establish an alternate exit identity.

Accept deferral of the seven non-pool Spider Walk/finger-crawling fact claims and six non-pool concept links. Canonical source supports internal Loop, Wait, Shoot, and tracking roles but does not independently connect them to the visible attack. This is an evidence limitation, not a rejection of that correspondence.
Accept deferral of the debug-mode interpretation. The Shoot IASA callback explicitly checks Human slot type, not debug mode; rendered naming cannot supply the missing provenance.
